name: angular-launchpad
description: Rapid Prototyping Backend with Angular Seed

scripts.clean: rm -rf www && rm -rf wardrobe_data && rm -rf coverage && rm -rf htmlcov && rm -f .coverage && rm -f *.pyc && rm -f launchpad/*.pyc && rm -f launchpad/*/*.pyc && rm -rf _trial_*
scripts.distclean: npm run clean && rm -rf node_modules && rm -rf wardrobe_data
scripts.prebuild: node -e "try { require.resolve('typescript') } catch (e) { console.log('Running npm install...'); require('child_process').execSync('npm install', {stdio: 'inherit'}); }"
scripts.test:py: python tools/python_coverage.py run -m unittest test.py && python tools/python_coverage.py report
scripts.test:py:html: python tools/python_coverage.py run -m unittest test.py && python tools/python_coverage.py html
